description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2096/81 of 10.11.2018, Kesbewa D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act.
